text: Gleis mit Personenverkehr: Strecken- und Perrongleise. Im Regionalplan nur diese.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,32.0H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

text: Güter-, Abstell-, Dienst- und Anschlussgleise. In grossen Knoten (Olten) im Regionalplan nur als Abgang angedeutet.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,32.0H140" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

text: Grüner Balken = Perronkante; Zahl im weissen Feld = Gleisnummer.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,43H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="30" y="28" width="90" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#00862f"/><rect x="62" y="36" width="26" height="14" fill="#fff"/><text x="75" y="48" font-size="15" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#00862f">3</text></svg>

text: Ein Gleis zweigt von einem anderen ab (immer 60°).
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,21H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M46.0,21Q50.0,21 52.0,24.5L60.7,39.5Q62.7,43 66.7,43H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

text: 2 Weichen: Verbindung zwischen zwei parallelen Gleisen in eine Richtung.

text: 4 Weichen: zwei Spurwechsel hintereinander, gegenläufig, mit kleiner Zwischengerade.

text: Gekreuzter Spurwechsel (auch Mittelstück): zwei Spurwechsel übereinander, mit Kreuzung in der Mitte.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,21H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M10,43H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M62.29829407782823,21L87.70170592217177,43" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M62.29829407782823,43L87.70170592217177,21" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

text: Zwei Gleise kreuzen ohne Verbindung (auch Überwerfung / Unterführung).
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,32.0H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M57.217611708959524,15L92.78238829104048,49" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

text: Gleisende (Stumpfgleis). Grün auf Hauptgleis, schwarz auf Nebengleis.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,21H120" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="120" cy="21" r="4.5" fill="#00862f"/><path d="M10,43H100" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="100" cy="43" r="3.2" fill="#111"/></svg>

text: Schmalspurgleis (1000 mm), braun; ohne Verbindung zur Normalspur. Dick = Strecken-/Perrongleis, dünn = Abstellgleis.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,21H140" fill="none" stroke="#9a5b1e" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M10,43H70" fill="none" stroke="#9a5b1e" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M70,43L82.70170592217177,21" fill="none" stroke="#9a5b1e" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

text: Nebengleis läuft über den Planausschnitt hinaus weiter.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,32.0H120" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M120,28.0L129,32.0L120,36.0Z" fill="#111"/></svg>

text: Nebengleis verlässt den Plan seitlich (schräger Stummel mit Pfeil).
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,21H140" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M60,21L73,43.5" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M77.5,51.3L69.5,45.5L76.5,41.5Z" fill="#111"/></svg>

text: Gleis wechselt die Höhe ohne Weiche. Nur wo es nicht anders geht.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,21H56.0Q60.0,21 62.0,24.5L70.7,39.5Q72.7,43 76.7,43H140" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>

text: Ende des Plans: Liniennummer und Richtung (Regionalplan).
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 150 64"><path d="M10,28.0H90" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M10,36.0H90" fill="none" stroke="#00862f" stroke-width="3.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="96" y="29.0" font-size="12" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#00862f">Linie 450</text><text x="96" y="44.0" font-size="12" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#00862f">Bern →</text></svg>

text: Halt ohne Weichen: kurze Perronstriche beidseits (Regionalplan).
